scope: Existing Json.parse.bytes or Users.name on HTTP bodies; parser/name validation and value disposal, not a strict Camber decoder or production server
deadline_setup: Timed read starts after complete body framing and both HTTP connections are accepted
timing_caveat: Native stdout buffering batched CPU_BEGIN and CPU_END, so host marker deltas and requests sent after receipt are not valid native parser/progress measurements. The initial pure-hoisting hypothesis was not confirmed; tagged native scheduler source identifies buffered stdout and flush-on-wait.
